wind.$comment: Prevailing ENE wind (~4.7 m/s) boosting eastern defenders' down-valley reach slightly less than attackers shooting uphill.

stoneBridges.$comment: Northern masonry crossing; immune to Rot, high deck above settled flow.

frozenPonds.$comment: Central ice sheet over deepened river pool (150 kg/m2 limit: carries crossing troops with visible strain unless overloaded or broken).
